Metadata.title: GoodTribes.org
Metadata.description: Connecting skilled volunteers with impact-driven organisations to build a better world together.

Footer.foundationBlurb: GoodTribes is a nonprofit foundation working toward long-term sustainable environmental and societal development. The foundation runs GoodTribes.org to help people and organisations who want to make the world better.
Footer.copyrightNote: Every project contributes to the 2030 Agenda
Footer.servicesBlurb: Explore the platform's features and ways to get involved.
Footer.organisationBlurb: Everything you need to know about the foundation behind GoodTribes.org.

SprintWorkspace.guidanceUnderstand: Collect "How Might We" questions about the problem on the canvas and in the list below. Contributions are anonymous here — focus on the idea, not who wrote it.
SprintWorkspace.guidanceDiverge: Sketch as many solutions as possible on the canvas. Still anonymous — breadth before perfection.
SprintWorkspace.guidanceDecide: Distribute your 3 dots across the sketches from the Sketch phase that you believe in most. Only the combined votes are shown, never who voted for what.
SprintWorkspace.guidancePrototype: Build a simple prototype of the winning idea and share a link to it.
SprintWorkspace.guidanceValidate: Test the prototype with real users and gather feedback.
